{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# 1. Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Check if any revenue has commas
print("Revenues with commas:", data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum())

# Strip commas and convert
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# 2. Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == 999999.99
print("QA orders found:", qa_mask.sum())
data = data[~qa_mask]

# 3. Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Refunded orders found:", refunded_mask.sum())
data = data[~refunded_mask]

# 4. Check for -1 in customer_age
print("customer_age == -1 before cleaning:", (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum())
# Note: -1 is a sentinel for missing, so we keep it as-is for now

# 5. Confirm the dataset after cleaning
print("Final shape:", data.shape)
print("Channel distribution:")
print(data['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:")
print(data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# 6. Check for confounding: cross-tabulate channel vs segment
print("\nCross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment")
print(pd.crosstab(data['channel'], data['customer_segment']))"}
